title: Sausage & Potato Traybake
author: Claude
description: Sausages roasted on one tray with potatoes, pepper, red onion and rosemary. Little washing-up.
steps: Toss the potatoes, onion and pepper with the olive oil, rosemary, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 15 minutes, then add the sausages and roast for 20 more, turning once, until everything is golden.
